title: Introduction to Data Science: Statistics and Prediction Algorithms Through Case Studies for CRFS
description: The second book of the Introduction to Data Science series, covering probability, statistical inference, regression, and machine learning through real-world case studies in R. Teaches students to think statistically — reasoning about uncertainty, model assumptions, and prediction — rather than just applying computational tools. Suitable for an advanced one-semester data science course. This variant is adapted for CRFS: the examples and context have been changed to fit CRFS work in Africa and the Sahel.
authors: Original by Rafael A. Irizarry; this variant is for CRFS
